THANK_YOU.pose_hint: Open hand held palm-in toward the chest

SORRY.pose_hint: Closed fist with thumb resting across the fingers

HELP.pose_hint: Thumb-up pose with palm turned inward

WAIT.pose_hint: Index, middle, and little fingers extended; ring finger and thumb folded

FINISHED.pose_hint: Thumb and index fingertips pinched together, other three fingers curled

I_DONT_UNDERSTAND.pose_hint: Index, ring, and little fingers extended; middle finger and thumb folded

REPEAT_PLEASE.pose_hint: Thumb, middle, and little fingers extended; index and ring folded

LEFT.pose_hint: Index finger extended horizontally to the user's left

RIGHT.pose_hint: Index finger extended horizontally to the user's right

NEXT.pose_hint: Index, middle, and ring extended; thumb and little finger folded

CONFIRM.pose_hint: Index finger and thumb touch to make a circle

CANCEL.pose_hint: Thumb extended sideways over a closed fist

SELECT.pose_hint: Index and thumb extended apart, other fingers folded

SMALL.pose_hint: Thumb and index held close together

THREE.pose_hint: Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended

RELAX.pose_hint: Loose open hand with fingers comfortably curved

OK.pose_hint: Thumb and middle fingertips touching, other fingers raised

WATER.pose_hint: Thumb and little finger extended; three middle fingers folded

REST.pose_hint: Open hand tilted diagonally with fingers together

HAPPY.pose_hint: Thumb and ring finger extended; index, middle, and little fingers folded

SAD.pose_hint: Index and ring fingers extended, others folded

PAIN.pose_hint: Index and little fingers extended, middle fingers folded

FRIEND.pose_hint: Thumb, ring, and little fingers extended

FAMILY.pose_hint: Both hands can be collected as one-hand proxy: thumb touches ring fingertip, other fingers raised
